## One bounded contribution · 一个有边界的贡献

What problem does this solve, and what stays out of scope?
解决什么问题？哪些内容不在本次范围？

## Privacy boundary · 隐私边界

What information crosses which boundary, for whose authorized purpose?
哪些信息跨越什么边界？服务于谁已授权的目的？

- [ ] No real personal/customer data, credentials, private methods or unpublished material are included. 不包含真实个人或客户资料、凭据、私人方法或未公开材料。
- [ ] The change does not silently widen purpose, recipients, onward sharing or retention. 不悄悄扩大目的、接收者、后续分享或留存范围。
- [ ] Boundary changes link to an RFC reviewed before implementation. 涉及边界变更时，链接至实施前审查的 RFC。

## Evidence · 验证证据

List commands actually run, results, failures and checks not run. Use synthetic fixtures.
列出实际运行的命令、结果、失败及未运行检查，使用合成夹具。

## Provenance and license scope · 来源与许可范围

List changed areas and any copied or adapted third-party material. Follow CONTRIBUTING.md.
列出变更区域及复制或改编的第三方材料，遵循 CONTRIBUTING.md。

- Apache collaboration ring: docs, specs, top-level tests and examples.
- Apache 协作层：文档、规范、顶层测试及示例。
- Community core: separate contribution rights must be resolved before merge.
- Community 核心：合并前须明确单独的贡献授权。

Submitting this form is not a copyright assignment or a core commercial relicensing agreement.
提交本表不等于版权转让或核心商业再许可协议。
